C: An all-traces guarantee or safe-yield may be preferable when probability intervals lack task justification; authored fixtures/threshold may not represent any application; correct arithmetic does not validate its model.
U: Authored exact-rational models only; no empirical delay calibration, wall-clock latency, GUI, OS input, task effect, safety, user tempo, runtime admission, or product evidence.
